'''Auren''' was a [[Planet/Legends|moon]] of [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]],<ref name="Auren" /> located within the [[Ingo system/Legends|Ingo system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Mid Rim" /> It was home to a [[Fromm Gang facility|facility]] operated by the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]], a crime family headquartered on the planet [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]]. The multi-level facility was involved in [[Mining/Legends|mining]], research, and other activities. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the complex, but they escaped and made their way to a higher story, where [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]] rescued them.

==Description==
Auren was located in the [[Ingo system/Legends|Ingo]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Auren" />

==History==
[[File:AaronsDroid-SWDG.png|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO and a Fromm droid]]
A crime family run by the corpulent [[Annoo-dat Blue]] [[Sise Fromm]], operated from the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]], the headquarters of the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]]. During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], circa [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Polyhedron">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> they established an eight-level [[Fromm Gang facility|facility]] on Ingo's moon, Auren.<ref name="Auren" /> There, they engaged in [[Mining/Legends|mining]], manufacturing, and research.<ref name="Auren" />

During this period, the Fromm Gang captured the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoning]] them deep within their Auren facility.<ref name="Auren" /> The two droids, a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] respectively, were at this time owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]], an inhabitant of [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]] who had numerous hostile encounters with the Fromm Gang.<ref name="Polyhedron" /> The droids managed to escape from their cell, ascending eight levels of the facility and evading capture from numerous [[Fromm Tower Droid]]s and other droid workers. Once out of the facility, they found Joben and his friend [[Jord Dusat]] waiting to rescue them from the planet.<ref name="Auren" />

==Inhabitants==
The Fromm Gang facility on Auren was staffed by a variety of droids. These included Fromm Tower droids, [[Sentry droid/Legends|guard droids]], [[repulsor ball]]s, [[Fiddler 10|Boiler droids]] and [[Snic 2-4-2|Strong Arm Droids]]; a mix of both [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] and bipedal designs.<ref name="Auren" />

==Locations==
The Fromm Gang facility on Auren contained at least eight levels, each allocated to a different purpose. The bottommost floor operated as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]], while built on top of this were mining, factory, and research levels. These were followed by a story allocated to domestic purposes, communication, security, and finally control. The levels were separated by [[Turbolift/Legends|elevators]] activated by entering the correct sequence of colored keys. Also installed at various points on the ceilings of these levels were gun emplacements.<ref name="Auren" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Congratulations! You escaped from the Fromm Gang! Jord and Thall are now waiting to rescue you from this planet.|The message on successful completion of ''Star Wars: Droids''|<ref name="SWDC64">[[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'' video game]] {{C|Commodore 64 version}}</ref>}}
[[File:Auren_titles.png|thumb|right|Auren from the Amstrad CPC version]]
Auren is the setting for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] released in [[1988]] for the [[Wikipedia:ZX Spectrum|ZX Spectrum]], [[Wikipedia:Amstrad CPC|Amstrad CPC]], [[Wikipedia:Atari ST|Atari ST]], and [[Wikipedia:Commodore 64|Commodore 64]] platforms. The game specifically makes mention of "the surface of Auren" as part of the game's onscreen text<ref name="SWDACPC">[[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'' video game]] {{C|Amstrad CPC version}}</ref> while the summary on the game's box also referred to the location as "Ingo's moon — Auren,"<ref name="Box">[[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'' video game]] box</ref> though its designation as a moon was absent from later sources as Auren was later erroneously referenced as "Aaron" in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online companion]] in the form of the "Aaron" system. The [[2013]] [[StarWars.com]] article ''[[The Droids Re-Animated]]'' also erroneously mentioned ''"planet Aaron"''.<ref name="TDRA">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
